column1: # ZAP baseline (passive) rules for a JSON API. Format: rule-id<TAB>action<TAB>(name).
# Actions: FAIL breaks the delivery, WARN and INFO are reported only (the scan runs with -I),
# IGNORE drops browser/HTML-only rules that cannot apply to JSON responses.
# Rules not listed here are reported as WARN. Ids: https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/
# Scope: unauthenticated and passive. It crawls from /health/live, so it sees the public health
# probes and the problem+json 404s around them; /v1 only ever answers 401 to it. Authorization
# (scopes, BOLA) is covered by tests/api/test_security.py and the contract tests, not by ZAP.
